incident_description: Severe congestion buildup caused shipment delays and container overflow during heavy rainfall.
High weather instability disrupted unloading operations and increased cargo delays.
Port congestion and labor shortages created major operational bottlenecks.
Container backlog increased significantly due to rising congestion and customs delays.
Extreme weather conditions and rising shipment delays impacted supply chain stability.
Congestion escalation caused unloading inefficiencies and operational slowdown.
Weather disruptions and container buildup caused shipment rerouting delays.
Heavy operational congestion increased average shipment delay times.
